compute: Explicitly supplied processors, accelerators or servers. A purchaser, operator or training service is not a supplier of those products.
semiconductor: Explicitly supplied semiconductor memory, semiconductor fabrication or semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Storage or generic components alone do not establish this role.
interconnect: Explicitly supplied data-center network connections or switches. Household or unspecified networking alone is insufficient.
power_cooling: Explicitly supplied digital-infrastructure power or cooling products. Household cooling or generic electrical products alone are insufficient.
cloud: Explicitly supplied cloud computing or cloud storage services. A company using or buying cloud services is not thereby a cloud supplier.
unknown: The excerpt does not directly establish an allowed role. This does not mean no business or no AI exposure.
periods: present_in_document, planned_in_document, past_in_document or unclear describe the document statement only; never current supply verification.
